name: Disobedient Wives
overview: Scripture calls wives to submit to their husbands as to the Lord, emphasizing this submission as fitting and honoring in the Christian life (Ephesians 5:22; Colossians 3:18). Disobedience in this role is linked to a broader pattern of walking in disobedience against God’s design (Ephesians 2:2). Proverbs highlights the turmoil caused by contentious behavior, warning that living with a quarrelsome wife brings strife to the home (Proverbs 21:9). Furthermore, Titus encourages older women to model holiness and avoid fostering conflict, teaching godly conduct that supports peace and order within the family (Titus 2:3).
